## Purpose

What audience or product problem does this change solve, and what should be better after it lands?

## Design rationale

- Relevant portfolio design principle or protected default:
- Intentional departure, if any:
- Design-decision ledger entry, if the direction materially changes:

## Evidence

- [ ] Latest normal commit passed the tracked hook's complete `ci --check` gate (or a manual run is explained because no commit followed)
- [ ] Changed routes and direct-route behaviour checked
- [ ] Claims, statuses, links, and asset custody checked
- [ ] No plaintext personal email address, phone number, or private path added

For visual changes, attach before/after evidence at 1440 and 390 CSS pixels and describe checks at 768, 320, keyboard-only, reduced motion, and 200% zoom.

For an intentional visual-baseline update, explain what changed and why the new image is the approved design rather than accidental drift.

## Accessibility and performance

Record affected axe, keyboard, reduced-motion, zoom, bundle-budget, and media-size evidence. Write “not affected” only when the diff genuinely cannot change that surface.
